name: HYDT
fix_description: Replace DataFetcher.quote() which reads spot AMM reserves (amountA * reserveB / reserveA) with a TWAP oracle (e.g., Chainlink BNB/USD feed) to prevent single-block reserve manipulation from inflating the minted HYDT amount.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a flash-loan-based price manipulation exploit that requires understanding how MintV2 incorrectly relies on the WBNB-USDT pair price during minting, plus coordinating several swaps across Pancake V2/V3 and a mint call. While the vulnerability pattern is recognizable, the multi-step flow and protocol-specific setup make it more involved than a simple access control or basic reentrancy bug.
